channel.title: Majestic Travels
channel.description: Slow travel stories, solo guides, and field notes by Adrien.

item.title: Fuerteventura Solo Travel: Surfing, Silence, and Morro Jable
item.description: I arrived restless and left quieter. A reflective story about the first wave, the long beach, and the relief of not needing to be impressive.

item.title: New York City in Summer: A Love Letter to the Greatest City on Earth
item.description: Rooftop sunsets, overheated sidewalks, late jazz, and the reason a loud city can still make you feel beautifully alone.

item.title: My First Surf Lesson in Fuerteventura and the Fear Before Standing Up
item.description: A grounded field note on beginner nerves, kind instruction, and the strange confidence that appears after falling repeatedly.

item.title: The Ultimate 5-Day NYC Itinerary for December Holiday Magic
item.description: A warm, walkable plan for lights, museums, winter food stops, Central Park, and the moments between the obvious sights.

item.title: The Travel Adapter Guide: Know Exactly What to Pack
item.description: Practical, visual, and calm. A post for the reader who is already at the airport and suddenly unsure about plug types.

item.title: The Slow Travel Quiz: What Kind of Wanderer Are You?
item.description: Less algorithm, more mirror. A reflective quiz that helps readers choose trips by energy, not just destination aesthetics.
